sources.entry: Overloop CLI - AI-powered outbound engine. Source 450M+ contacts, launch email + LinkedIn campaigns, manage conversations. JSON output, agent-native. npm i -g overloop-cli

summary.one_liner: A command-line client for the Overloop sales-automation API v2 that lets developers and AI agents manage prospects, campaigns, sourcings, and conversations with JSON output.
summary.what_it_does: The CLI wraps the Overloop API v2 with commands for prospects, organizations, lists, campaigns, campaign steps, enrollments, sourcings, conversations, users, custom fields, sending addresses, and an exclusion list. Campaigns can be created with inline steps (delay, email) and activated or paused from the terminal. Sourcings can be estimated, created, started, paused, and cloned, with search options queried by field. Enrollments can be created individually or in bulk (up to 100 prospects). Every command prints JSON, so output can be piped into jq or read by an AI agent. Authentication is via an interactive login that stores an API key in ~/.overloop/config.json, or via the OVERLOOP_API_KEY environment variable.
use_cases: source prospects by job title and location
manage a blocklist of emails and domains
script sales workflows from the terminal
let an AI agent operate an outbound sales pipeline
notable: Agent-native: ships a SKILL.md installable into AI agents such as Cursor and Claude Code
All command output is JSON for scripting and piping
Sourcing estimate previews match counts before creating a sourcing
Inline campaign steps are chained automatically, avoiding manual step linking
caveats: Beta: APIs and tool interfaces may change between versions
API rate limit is 600 requests per minute per key
Individually created campaign steps must be chained with --previous-step-id or they do not appear in the UI
